10721|738b752e.name: Novice Warrior
10721|738b752e.text: Are you here to prove yourself as well?

11029|28ea6aca.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|28ea6aca.text: You'll need to prove your worthiness before I go giving away my secrets! I've got just the test for you...

2238|5408b909.name: Tog'thar
2238|5408b909.text: Marlgen... One of the jailors. He has the key to my bonds.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

251371|c4bcd3c9.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|c4bcd3c9.text: Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.

251903|243962a6.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|243962a6.text:
The Cult? They are zealots and killers. They believe that we are being punished for some unspecific sin. The reality is that those that lead them are opportunists left over from a dubious order of so-called "Priests" of Al'Akir, the Windlord.

They now find themselves in a position to weaponize the fear of our people to consolidate their own power... and they have been quick to do so.

251903|4cf13d24.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|4cf13d24.text:
You must remember that while this realm has been our home for millennia, we will always be somewhat alien to this place. We are not in the terrestrial world that birthed our people. We are in the realm of Skywall, the elemental plane of air.

We arrived here as the guests of spirits with whom we found kinship in ages past. Now that we shen'dorei find ourselves bereft of their presence--and potentially--their protection, there's no telling how the other denizens of this plane may perceive us.

251903|614c99de.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|614c99de.text: Alas, I have prattled on long enough. Should you find yourself in the port of Valanaar, seek out Elaadrin Evengale. Elaadrin was once my student, but now he serves as the Chief Magister of the High Order. He is headstrong and capable, and it's now up to him and young $R such as yourself to carry the hopes for our people forward.

251903|6e10b87b.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|6e10b87b.text: Where to begin? Our home is failing. The wards have fallen and the three provinces have begun to drift apart. There was a time not long ago when the spires of Shen'dramar were visible from the western watchtower. No longer. Day by day the wind pylons that anchor our home to this plane weaken...

251903|7f6ee31d.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|7f6ee31d.text:
Even the Windshapers would tell you that the spirits never spoke highly of any supreme being amongst them. They acknowledged the existence of a being named Al'Akir, but they avoided invoking his name, almost as if they feared him.

Even if this Al'Akir is an all-powerful "Windlord" or ruler of the wind elementals, relying upon elementals is what got us into this mess. We must now see ourselves out of it.

251903|b7c70fc4.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|b7c70fc4.text: Many disagree on this point. The Windshapers would have you believe that joining hands and merely hoping for the spirits' return will be sufficient. Their order's power has waned, however, and their path relies on putting us back on the cycle of dependence that got us to this point. The High Order, on the other hand... we believe in a more direct approach.

251903|bbdd6b3f.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|bbdd6b3f.text:
Why is this happening? Put simply, the spirits of the wind just... vanished. 

The petty sprites and lesser elementals you've likely encountered out there are a pale imitation of the true spirits of wind. Non-sentient, aimless, and a far cry from the kindly spirits we lived in harmony alongside for thousands of years.

251905|48ad85dc.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|48ad85dc.text: Ho there, traveler! New to town? Well, once you get settled in, come see me if you'd like some work. I've been working overtime preparing for the Festival of Winds and I'll take all the help I can get keeping the larders full!

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

251964|fe3406a9.name: Blademaster Ren
251964|fe3406a9.text: The warrior who flinches is the warrior who dies. If you would look death in the face as a warrior, I will teach you how not to flinch.

251968|4f475817.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|4f475817.text:
<Ayessa Dawnsinger eyes you with barely-contained fury.> 

You are either very bold, or very stupid to so brazenly step foot into our domain after spilling Windshaper blood. We are slow to forgive, and we never forget. 

You should remove yourself from here at once. If we weren't in the center of Zephras, you would already be dead.

251968|51e58459.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|51e58459.text:
Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The Windshapers will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

<Ayessa lowers her voice dangerously.> 

Do not mistake our cooperation for any sort of forgiveness. You owe the Windshapers blood, and someday we will collect.

252379|a046a01a.name: Eltheen Nightbreeze
252379|a046a01a.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the $c, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

252388|5c2244b7.name: Halavuul Cragwind
252388|5c2244b7.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

252475|53576371.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|53576371.text:
I see. This seems dangerous in the extreme, but the situation seems to demand that risks be taken.

Very well, the High Order will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

252475|e863f079.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|e863f079.text:
The Windshapers are almost wholly to blame for everything that has happened. Their refusal to change has damaged our ability to save ourselves from our current peril. They speak in absolutes and treat assumptions and superstitious hope as fact.

Do you know who else deals only in absolutes? The Al'Aketh. 

I for one do not intend to let blind adherence to dangerous beliefs doom our people. If it weren't for the threat of the cult, I'd march our mages over to the other side of Valanaar and wipe the Windshapers out.

252479|c65683ed.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

253004|1a6886aa.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

253474|823817d9.name: Peacekeeper
253474|823817d9.text:
Engineer? What in Skywall is that?

Now that you mention it... I think I may have heard that drunk Sirrocas over at the inn talking about some sort of forest spirit that he claimed to have encountered that called itself an "engineer."

That was the first I'd ever heard of such a thing.

I believe he said that this particular spirit could be found somewhere in Shadowgale Forest, but I can't recommend you go to that cursed place!

253847|6ace422f.name: Elaadrin Evengale
253847|6ace422f.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

254087|a046a01a.name: Miriaan Mistblade
254087|a046a01a.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the $c, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

254100|157bb7b8.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|157bb7b8.text:
Have you seen them? The skycutters are running again! I've heard that we still have no contact with the other shen'dorei islands, though.

I hope we re-establish contact with Shen'dramar and Eldranaar soon... if they are even still out there.

256635|824cc722.name: Peacekeeper
256635|824cc722.text: Adventurer! The wind bridge leading to the other spire is unstable. You may need to wait here with me until it returns.

257007|2957a3a0.name: Melasa Fairmend
257007|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

257018|2957a3a0.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

257018|c65683ed.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257022|5c2244b7.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|5c2244b7.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

259084|637067e7.name: Denaaris Stargale
259084|637067e7.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow $R quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

263570|954d4e6d.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|954d4e6d.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders.  As you improve your standing with the  Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a selection of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

267007|7d21b53a.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|7d21b53a.text:
You can find Stormwind Harbor if you head through the Canals, between the Cathedral District and the Park.

Were you looking for a specific destination?

267007|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

268511|ee845bad.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
268511|ee845bad.text: Harbor work is open to everyone, but your personal safety is your own responsibility.

268925|17da1992.name: Night Elf Courier
268925|17da1992.text: The night elf is motionless, with multiple wounds and discoloration emblematic of suffering from poison.

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

272045|5a3e1b84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|5a3e1b84.text:
Why are you looking at me like that? Do you expect me to shoot bolts of lightning at you, or threaten you with the wrath of the Windlord?

It's fair enough if you do. However, not all of us are quite so... zealous.

272045|d5d1dc84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|d5d1dc84.text:
Tailor, by trade. 

Here, stranger, I'll tell you what. Bring me any spare windstones you come across and I'll share my wares with you. I've got quite the stockpile of Al'Aketh garments here. Say what you will about the insanity of the cult, you've got to admit, they have some sense of style.

Or rather, I do, considering I designed most of their attire.

272045|fac7c2e1.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|fac7c2e1.text:
Not much story to tell. I lived in Falaath Village and when the cult moved in, I saw the winds turning. I shaved my head, donned the grey robes, and said the words they wanted to hear. 

Now I'm just trying to survive. Mostly I keep my head down and ply my trade for that crackpot, Lorthuna.

275491|0edd6da8.name: Randal Emerson
275491|0edd6da8.text: Greetings, citizen. How may I help you today?

275491|9fd8120c.name: Randal Emerson
275491|9fd8120c.text:
Ah yes, he mentioned that an agent of the High Order would be arriving in Stormwind soon. He asked me to draft instructions for you.

<Randal hands you a neatly sealed note.>

This should give you all the information you need. You are in for quite the journey, $N. I wish you luck on behalf of Stormwind and the Alliance.

276170|e50e47b5.name: Belanaa Windveil
276170|e50e47b5.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

2784|970770be.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
2784|970770be.text:
Ah, so you have. You are most welcome in Ironforge, $c. 

This city is the seat of the Bronzebeard Clan. We are an ancient and proud people and our craftsmen are second to none. You'll find no finer creations of metal or stonework than those of dwarven-make.

We are also amongst the boldest of explorers on Azeroth. If you have a taste for adventure, you will be in good company amongst our people.

Thank you for speaking with me, $N. Go now with the blessings of the Bronzebeard Clan. 

I wish you and your people well.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

3293|5bfb096f.name: Rezlak
3293|5bfb096f.text: I'm happy Gazlowe gave me the opportunity to be here and all, but this place is more dangerous than I thought it'd be. It's also really hot. And dusty. And it smells kinda weird. Ah, well! Hopefully it will be good for business.

3326|86b6c1ef.name: Zevrost
3326|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

3338|e2ff6310.name: Sergra Darkthorn
3338|e2ff6310.text: The land, the water, and the sky are all as one. It is your eyes that deceive you with such separation. The Earthmother is all those things and more.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3484|b1b31af6.name: Kil'hala
3484|b1b31af6.text: Dat's da attitude! Grab a needle and thread and let's get jammin'!

3484|e50c189b.name: Kil'hala
3484|e50c189b.text: At dis point you know as much as I do, mon. Maybe you go see Magar in Orgrimmar. He not be da happiest tailor around, but he help you anyway.

4049|65e1afb2.name: Seereth Stonebreak
4049|65e1afb2.text: The spirit of Stonetalon weeps.  It weeps from its mountain peaks, to its rivers, to its severed, dying trees.

68|2b59109b.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|2b59109b.text: A $c?  Hmmm... well, I've heard that Keryn Sylvius hangs around those shady types.  You might want to talk to her and see what you can learn.

7937|51417c16.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|51417c16.text: Hello there, $c. I am High Tinker Mekkatorque of the exiles of Gnomeregan.

7937|825d4590.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|825d4590.text:
Oh yes, how wonderful! I have been expecting an emissary from your people, and I am very happy to make your acquaintance.

I do wish I could receive you in our home city of Gnomeregan, but our people have recently fallen on hard times and our homeland is, at present, lost to us.

King Bronzebeard is ever a friend to us gnomes, however, and has graciously opened his city to us in this difficult time. 

I hope that your adventures on Azeroth treat you well, and I look forward to further opportunities to learn more of your people. 

Farewell, $N.

7999|3d397bbf.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999|3d397bbf.text: Greetings, $c. I am Tyrande Whisperwind, High Priestess of Elune.

7999|ccf70497.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999|ccf70497.text:
It pleases me greatly to at last meet one of your people. I've heard much of the shen'dorei and your long history, and I am glad to see our cousins return home to Kalimdor at long last.

I confess that our people have a... complicated relationship with the highborne. Some amongst the night elves are quick to distrust those of highborne descent such as those in your High Order. However, you have my assurance that you will be shown the utmost respect while a guest in our city.

Please, make yourself at home here. I'd encourage you to explore and familiarize yourself with our culture. It is, after all, your culture as well in a way.

1065-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-progress.text: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
1065-progress.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1066-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-progress.text: Did you find the Syndicate Shadow Mages, and collect from them the blood?
1066-progress.title: Blood of Innocents

1067-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-progress.text: You have returned, $N.  Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?
1067-progress.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1096-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-progress.text: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
1096-progress.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

3090-progress.name: Nartok
3090-progress.text:
Finally, you've arrived... and discreetly also. Good.

Our world is full of fools, $N. Even the mighty Thrall has greater flaws than most can see. He turns his back on the power needed to make this land ours completely! We're not the same people who were manipulated and used by creatures from the Nether. We are our own people. We are proud... and we are strong.
3090-progress.title: Tainted Parchment

3091-progress.name: Harutt Thunderhorn
3091-progress.text: Ah, at last, you've arrived, $c. I did not lie in my note, $N. We are a special breed also, not unlike the druids or shamans of our tribe. You are just as important. We are the ones called upon to defend our borders, to hunt the centaur, and to go to war.
3091-progress.title: Simple Note

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

3861-progress.name: Chicken
3861-progress.text:
The chicken stares at you with dark, cold eyes. It waits for you hungrily.

"BACAAAW!

Cluck...cluck...cluck."
3861-progress.title: CLUCK!

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6365-progress.name: Devrak
6365-progress.text: You need to get somewhere fast?  Then you're talking to the right $r!
6365-progress.title: Meats to Orgrimmar

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6421-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6421-progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
6421-progress.title: Boulderslide Ravine

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

7826-progress.name: Rashona Straglash
7826-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Orgrimmar for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7826-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

816-progress.name: Misha Tor'kren
816-progress.text: I pray that Kron will return to me, but I'm almost certain I know his fate already.
816-progress.title: Lost But Not Forgotten

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

850-progress.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have Barak's Head for me?
850-progress.title: Kolkar Leaders

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

92483-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92483-accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.

He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.
92483-accept.title: At Home in the Shadows

92483-complete.name: Akeri Duskblade
92483-complete.text:
I almost did not hear you approach me, young $c.

Almost.

Almost won't be good enough when you leave Thendal Grove. You must be a slender blade, silent and steady. Ever vigilant and ever mindful of your surroundings. You might have what it takes to survive the dangers of Zephras. You also might end up with your throat slit in a ditch. Ultimately that's entirely up to you.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92483-complete.title: At Home in the Shadows

92596-accept.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-accept.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596-accept.title: The High Order

92693-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-progress.text: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
92693-progress.title: Standing Our Ground

92701-progress.name: Valennia Stormfist
92701-progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92701-progress.title: To Valanaar

92741-progress.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-progress.text: The High Order do not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
92741-progress.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92834-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-progress.text: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
92834-progress.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-progress.text:
It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.

They see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?
92840-progress.title: Catching Wind

92850-progress.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92850-progress.text: Those shrieklings are too dangerous to be left to nest this close to Valanaar. However... they are the least of our troubles.
92850-progress.title: The Missing Scholar

94414-progress.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
94414-progress.text:
My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.

Appreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.
94414-progress.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94947-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
94947-complete.text:
Well met, $c. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to receive members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, $R.
94947-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

95774-progress.name: Mankrik
95774-progress.text: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774-progress.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95805-progress.name: Unknown
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95883-accept.name: Unknown
95883-accept.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The $r around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883-accept.title: The Tortured Soul

96102-accept.name: Brakk
96102-accept.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102-accept.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96102-complete.name: Snang
96102-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96102-complete.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer

96873-progress.name: Pa'zula
96873-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?
96873-progress.title: A Pain in the Neck

96986-accept.name: Melisara
96986-accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the $c city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the $c city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986-accept.title: The Grave Knight

97220-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97220-progress.text: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220-progress.title: Philmor's Favor

97242-progress.name: Kor'geld
97242-progress.text: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.
97242-progress.title: Yelmak's Medley

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces

97281-accept.name: Unknown
97281-accept.text:
<Before you is a strange orb and with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281-accept.title: A Simmering Storm

97282-progress.name: Rezlak
97282-progress.text:
It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.

Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.

Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
97282-progress.title: Stormy Potential

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

97901-complete.name: Jhag
97901-complete.text:
There you have it, you can craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out.

No camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.
97901-complete.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97970-progress.name: Messana Crestwind
97970-progress.text: I can train you if you have the aptitude.
97970-progress.title: Camping 101: Mining

99052-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99052-accept.text:
One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.

It's a young one, but it could still rip an $r in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
99052-accept.title: Threat from Below

99052-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99052-complete.text:
Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!

Be proud of your kill today, not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.
99052-complete.title: Threat from Below

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Our journey together shall take many strides, but this step is no less important than the others.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or mace. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Enter our space, and learn through combat. You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99191-progress.name: Belanaa Windveil
99191-progress.text:
The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions. Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99191-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
